Name: Dickshrooms
Author: AmbyLeaf
Description:
Just a simple little mod to learn and test some stuff, while adding a bit more adult content to Stardew Valley

This will add some erotic mushrooms to your game that you can grow as a crop ^^

These mushrooms will regrow after being harvested, they can grow in spring, summer, and fall, and the seeds can be bought in any of those seasons from Pierre's Shop (Look for Musky Spores ;) )

Will now give +20 Luck and Max Stamina when you eat the fully grown shroom for 7 minutes


[color=#FF54D1][b]Also, would like to say that I'm looking for suggestions for other NSFW tweaks to do to the game, I already know that I wanna do something with the mailbox, and would love to edit the shipping bin (not sure what I can even do to the shipping bin), but also open to suggestions for other stuff, if you guys have ideas, feel free to post them in the comments, and I'll see what I can make happen ^^[/b][/color]
